title: EasyLife
description: Adds simple but powerful items to make survival easier and more fun. Gain speed, jump higher, and heal instantly with minimal effort.
body:
## ✨ About This Mod

This mod adds a small set of simple but useful items to improve everyday survival gameplay. It keeps the vanilla feeling while making things faster and more fun.

## ⚡ Features

* Speed boost item to move faster
* Jump boost item for higher jumps
* Instant healing food item

## 🎯 Purpose

Designed for players who want a lightweight and practical mod without changing the core mechanics. Simple, balanced, and useful for everyone.
